signals.text: 5 open PM roles across 2 US offices

news.title: Flexport launches AI automated freight booking and tracking
Flexport launches MCP Server for AI agents to book freight
Flexport Launches Technology to Let AI Agents Book, Track, and Optimize Global Freight

roles.title: Senior Product Manager, Visibility
roles.location: Bellevue, Washington, United States; San Francisco, California, United States

bullets: Define and deliver product features for end-to-end mapping, tracking, and visibility of physical goods across the shipment lifecycle
Own your product area end-to-end, building and executing product roadmaps spanning 12 to 18 months
Drive data intelligence at an end-to-end level to solve complex operational problems and define client-facing tracking experiences
Partner across execution, planning, and technology teams to align priorities and translate complex logistics workflows into intuitive systems
Collaborate closely across a global footprint (Hong Kong, Eu rope, US) with China engineering teams, participating in regular cross-border syncs

roles.title: Senior Product Manager, Commerce
roles.location: Bellevue, Washington, United States; San Francisco, California, United States

bullets: Define and deliver product features that improve key commerce workflows for internal operators and clients across Flexport’s platform
Own your product area end-to-end, building and executing product roadmaps spanning 12 to 18 months
Build intelligent AI agents to automate core commerce operations, including quoting, billing, and invoicing
Partner with Engineering, Design, Sales, Operations, and other cross-functional teams to translate complex logistics workflows into clear, intuitive experiences
Collaborate closely across a global footprint with engineering teams in the West Coast US and China, participating in regular cross-border syncs

roles.title: Staff Product Manager, Commerce
roles.location: Bellevue, Washington, United States; San Francisco, California, United States

bullets: Define and drive product strategy across the Commerce domain that spans multiple teams, user types, or workflow stages
Build intelligent AI agents to automate core commerce operations, including quoting, billing, and invoicing
Own the end-to-end roadmap: identifying the highest-leverage problems, sequencing investment, and making clear trade-off recommendations to leadership
Partner with Engineering, Design, Sales, Operations, and other product teams to align priorities and ship integrated experiences across surfaces
Collaborate closely across a global footprint with engineering teams in the West Coast US and China, participating in regular cross-border syncs
Own the vision and strategy for Flexport’s unified Trucking Technology stack across planning, procurement, pricing, and carrier experience.
Lead the end-to-end trucking unification program, managing cross-domain change management and platform migration risks.
Drive automation and AI initiatives, such as automated dispatch and appointment scheduling, to remove manual work from the cargo lifecycle.
Deliver measurable business impact by optimizing cost-to-serve, procurement savings, and carrier performance metrics.
Reengineer and digitize underlying trucking workflows to establish a leaner operating model.

bullets: Define and drive product strategy across the Visibility domain that spans multiple teams, user types, or workflow stages

Drive end-to-end data intelligence to solve complex operational problems and define next-generation client-facing visibility experiences
Partner across execution, planning, and technology teams to align priorities and ship integrated systems across surfaces
Collaborate closely across a global footprint (Hong Kong, Europe, US) with China engineering teams, participating in regular cross-border syncs
